package_info.package_versions: All versions served after acquisition by Funnull
package_info.why_malicious: The entire cdn.polyfill.io service began serving JavaScript with dynamic, targeted malicious payloads after its acquisition by Funnull. The scripts inject code that redirects users to scam/phishing sites, exfiltrates data, and evades detection by targeting only specific users and devices. This turns a widely trusted supply chain resource into a large-scale attack vector.

execution_context.trigger: runtime (when script is loaded in end-user browser)
execution_context.file_location: JavaScript served from cdn.polyfill.io, injected into any website including the script

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code checks if the user is on a mobile device, is not an admin, and no analytics scripts are present; if so, after a delay, it redirects the user to a fake Google Analytics domain, leading to phishing or scam sites.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Conditional redirection to external domains based on user/device context is a classic sign of malicious web injection, especially when targeting only certain users and evading detection.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: A polyfill library is expected to provide JavaScript compatibility functions, not to perform user targeting, redirection, or interact with analytics/admin detection.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Some legitimate scripts may redirect users for A/B testing or mobile optimization, but not with evasive logic and to suspicious domains.
key_indicators: Dynamic payload generation based on HTTP headers/user agent

execution_context.trigger: runtime (when script is loaded in end-user browser)
execution_context.file_location: JavaScript served from cdn.polyfill.io, injected into any website including the script

malicious_snippets.code_behavior: At runtime, the code checks for mobile device and absence of admin/analytics, then exfiltrates user cookies, local storage, and current URL to a malicious external domain via HTTP POST.

malice_analysis.why_suspicious: Exfiltrating sensitive browser data to an external domain is a hallmark of credential theft and user tracking attacks.
malice_analysis.violated_expectations: Polyfill scripts should not access or transmit user data; their role is limited to providing compatibility functions.
malice_analysis.similar_legitimate_use: Legitimate analytics scripts may collect some data, but not with evasive logic or to untrusted domains.

attack_chain.action: Website includes cdn.polyfill.io script, which is fetched by the end-user's browser.
attack_chain.leads_to: Malicious JavaScript is loaded into the user's browser.

attack_chain.action: Malicious JavaScript checks user context (device type, admin status, analytics presence) and dynamically generates payload.
attack_chain.leads_to: Payload is selectively executed for targeted users.

attack_chain.action: For targeted users, the script either redirects to phishing/scam sites or exfiltrates sensitive data.
attack_chain.leads_to: User data theft, phishing, or further compromise.

behavioral_signatures: Third-party JavaScript performing conditional redirection based on user agent or environment
JavaScript exfiltrating cookies/localStorage to non-standard domains
Scripts delaying execution or checking for analytics/admin presence before acting
file_indicators: Inclusion of cdn.polyfill.io in website <script> tags
References to fake Google Analytics or suspicious redirect domains in loaded scripts
network_indicators: Outbound requests to domains like fake-google-analytics.com, malicious-domain.com, or other non-polyfill domains from browser context
POST requests containing cookies or localStorage data to unknown domains
detection_knowledge.how_to_detect: Monitor for inclusion of cdn.polyfill.io scripts in web applications. Use Content Security Policy (CSP) reports to detect unexpected redirects or data exfiltration attempts. Analyze loaded JavaScript for conditional logic targeting specific users/devices and for network requests to suspicious domains. Flag scripts that access cookies/localStorage and send data to non-whitelisted endpoints, especially if they evade execution in admin or analytics environments.
